Dr John Smith

6 Fairway Road

Corinda QLD 4075



Dear Dr Smith,



Re: Mrs Sierra Fredrick, DOB 8/2/2019                                                                                                   Commented [May1]: I added this to provide more
                                                                                                                                        information to the reader. This has also been suggested by
                                                                                                                                        OET, so you might want to consider using this format (and
                                                                                                                                        include the DOB here). Alternatively, you can do it like how
                                                                                                                                        you wrote your first letter.

I am writing to inform you about discharge Mrs Fredrick , who is being discharged from our

hospital back in to into your care. start a new sentence here after presenting to the                                                   Commented [May2]: ‘into’ is one word


Emergency Department due to a fall. Your further follow-up, including ordering TFT, HbA1c                                               Commented [May3]: I deleted this part because it is
                                                                                                                                        repeated in the next paragraph.

and MSU tests would be greatly acknowledged appreciated In addition, she as she requires                                                Commented [May4]: This is wrong information because the
                                                                                                                                        tests have already been ordered and you mentioned this in a
                                                                                                                                        subsequent paragraph as well.
an assessment from the aged care assessment team Aged Care Assessment Team regarding

her for home and personal assistance, and a referral to an endocrinologist to assess her

osteopenia and a geriatric review are also recommended.



On 7/12/2019, Mrs Fredrick was brought in by ambulance after she fell while descending

the stairs at home. Her neighbor heard her crying for help, and he found her setting sitting                                            Commented [May5]: You can be specific. This piece of
                                                                                                                                        information is important because it will tie in with your
                                                                                                                                        suggestion about having the Aged Care Assessment Team
down on the staircase wearing wet clothes. Additionally, sShe was oriented to place and                                                 assess her home.
                                                                                                                                        Commented [May6]: No comma if you are linking 2 clauses
                                                                                                                                        with the conjunction ‘and’.

person, and she was competent in decision making. As a result, a hip fracture was

suspected. Although her neighbor tried to contact her son, he was not reachable.                                                        Commented [May7]: The use of ‘as a result’ is wrong here.
                                                                                                                                        The sentence before this was ‘she was competent in decision
                                                                                                                                        making’. Being competent in decision making does not result
                                                                                                                                        in a hip fracture. Anyway, I have deleted this sentence
                                                                                                                                        because the next paragraph talks about her imaging results.

Upon Mrs Fredrick ‘s On examination, a full range of movement in her bilateral hips was

detected, and only few bruises in her right elbow were seen. To add, sShe was able to move                                              Commented [May8]: No comma.
                                                                                                                                        Commented [May9]: Not necessary.
without pain. start a new sentence here. A pelvis and hip X-ray did not show any fractures

but and all her imaging’s were unremarkable apart from osteopenia that was noted. TFT,

HbA1c and MSU tests were ordered, and they the results will be available tomorrow.                                                      Commented [May10]: No comma.


Consequently, she will be discharged today with nNo changes in were made to her regular                                                 Commented [May11]: You do not need to repeat this.


medications.



In light of the above, your continuous care and management of Mrs Fredrick ‘s condition                                                 Commented [May12]: You do not need a space before the
                                                                                                                                        apostrophe.

would be highly appreciated. If you require any further clarification, please do not hesitate

to get in contact.



Yours sincerely,

Doctor

 Overall               You have organised this letter in a logical manner but you need to be
 Comments              careful with the information you put in your letter as some parts
                       contradicted others (e.g. the part about ordering the tests). Please put
                       more effort into your language in these areas (some of which I have
                       mentioned before):
                            Sentence structure
                            Signal markers
                            Punctuation

                       Please read as many examples of medical letters as you can because they
                       contain a rich source of suitable language for your letters. Here is a good

                       https://oetonline.net.au/mod/page/view.php?id=16993

                       I also suggest that you rewrite this letter using my suggestions (just copy it
